_comment: Configuration for verified.js — identifier-based discovery against OpenAlex. ROR & ORCIDs are deterministic; funder IDs are optional but highly valuable when known.
_comment_funders: Look these up via https://api.openalex.org/funders?search=auscope and https://api.openalex.org/funders?search=ncris . Add any matches as bare IDs without the F prefix is fine (e.g. 'F4320XXXXXX'). Leave [] if none confirmed.
_comment_partners: AuScope partner institutions. Used to corroborate ORCID-only hits (paper from a watchlist researcher AT a partner is more likely AuScope-relevant). Edit liberally — these are illustrative starting RORs; verify each before relying on them.
_comment_partner_names: Above RORs correspond roughly to: ANU, U Sydney, U Tasmania, Curtin, U Adelaide, U Melbourne, Geoscience Australia, CSIRO. CHECK each at ror.org before relying.
